The total expenditure on all these categories in 2006 is what percentage (rounded off to two places of decimals) of the total expenditure in 2009?
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure in 2006:

Salary: 225 , Fuel and Transport: 98 , Bonus: 4.25 , Interest on Loan: 29.7 , Taxes: 110

Expenditure in 2009:

Salary: 295, Fuel and Transport: 145 , Bonus: 6.25 , Interest on Loan: 49.6 , Taxes: 118

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Total Expenditure in 2006 / Total Expenditure in 2009) × 100

**Calculations:**

Total Expenditure in 2006 = 225 + 98 + 4.25 + 29.7 + 110 = 466.95

Total Expenditure in 2009 = 295 + 145 + 6.25 + 49.6 + 118 = 613.85

Percentage = (466.95 / 613.85) × 100

⇒ Percentage ≈ 76.06%

**∴ The total expenditure in 2006 is approximately 76.06% of the total expenditure in 2009.**
